m: 1. वह् cl. 1. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxiii, 35) वहति, ˚ते (in later language Ā. only mc.; Vedic forms which may partly belong to the aor. are वक्षि, वोढम्, ˚ढाम् or वो|अम्, ˚|आम्, उहीत, वक्ष्व, वोढ्वम्, ऊढ्वम्, उहान; pf. उवाह, ऊहुः; ऊहे, RV. &c. &c.; ववाह, ˚हतुः, MBh.; aor. Ved. अवाक्षीत् or अवाट् Subj. वक्षत्, ˚अति, Prec. उह्यात्; अवक्षि, अवोढ Gr.; fut. वोढा, Br.; वक्ष्यति, ˚ते, AV. &c.; वहिष्यति, MBh. &c.; inf. वोढुम्, RV. &c. &c. [Ved. also ˚ढवे and ˚ढवै]; वाहे, RV.; वहध्यै, ib.; ind.p. ऊढ्वा, Br.; -उह्य, AV. &c. &c.; cf. √ 1. ऊह्), to carry, transport, convey (with instr. of vehicle), RV. &c. &c.; to lead, conduct (esp. offerings to the gods, said of Agni), ib.; to bear along (water, said of rivers), ib.; to draw (a car), guide (horses &c.), ib.; to lead towards, to bring, procure, bestow, Kāv.; Kathās.; to cause, effect, BhP.; to offer (a sacrifice), ib.; to spread, diffuse (scent), Kathās.; to shed (tears), BhP.; to carry away, carry off, rob, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to lead home, take to wife, marry, RV. &c. &c.; to bear or carry on or with (loc. or instr.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to take or carry with or about one's self, have, possess, Kāv.; Pur.; Rājat.; to wear (clothes), Mṛcch.; (with शिरस्) to bear one's head (उच्चैश्-तराम्, ‘high’), Hariv.; (with वसुंधराम् or क्ष्मा-मण्डालम्) to support i.e. rule the earth, Rājat.; (with गर्भम्) to be with child, Pañcat.; to bear, suffer, endure, Kāv.; Pur.; to forbear, forgive, pardon, BhP.; to undergo (with अग्निम्, विषम्, तुलाम्, ‘the ordeal of fire, poison, and the balance’), Yājñ.; to experience, feel, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to exhibit, show, betray, ib.; to pay (a fine), Yājñ.; to pass, spend (time), Rājat.; (intrans.) to drive, ride, go by or in (with instr. of the vehicle), be borne or carried along, run, swim &c., RV. &c. &c.; to draw (scil. a carriage, said of a horse), Mn. viii, 146; to blow (as wind), Kāv.; Sāh.; to pass away, elapse, Hcar. : Pass. उह्यते (ep. also ˚ति; aor. अवाहि), to be carried (उह्यमान, ‘being c˚’) &c.; to be drawn or borne by (instr.) or along or off, RV. &c. &c.: Caus. वाहयति (mc. also ˚ते; aor. अवीवहत्; Pass. वाह्यते), to cause to bear or carry or convey or draw (with two acc. Pāṇ. i, 4, 52, Vārtt. 6 Pat.), drive (a chariot), guide or ride (a horse), propel (a boat), go or travel by any vehicle, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to cause to guide (two acc.), Vop.; to cause any one (acc.) to carry anything (acc.) on (loc.), MBh.; to cause to take in marriage, ib.; to cause to be conveyed by (instr.), Ragh.; Rājat.; to traverse (a road), Ragh.; to accomplish (a journey), Megh.; to employ, keep going or in work, Mn. iii, 68; iv, 86; to give, administer (see वाहित); to take in, deceive (see id.) : Desid. विवक्षति, ˚ते Gr.: Intens. वनीवाह्यते, to carry hither and thither (cf. वनीवाहन and वनीवाहित); वावहीति, to bear (a burden), Subh.; वावह्यते, वावोढि Gr.
वह् [cf. Gk. ὄχος for ϝοχος, ὀχέομαι; Lat. vehere, vehiculum; Slav. vesti; Lith. vèżti; Goth. gawigan; Germ. wëgan, bewegen; Eng. weigh.]

2. वह् (ifc.; strong form वाह् weak form ऊह् or उह्, which with a preceding अ coalesces into औ; cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 64; iv, 1, 61) carrying, drawing, bearing, holding (cf. अनड्-उह्, अप्सु-वह्, इन्द्र-वह् &c.).
a: वह् — {c1c} U. (वहति-ते, उवाह, ऊहे, अवाक्षीत्, अवोढ, वक्ष्यति-ते, वोढुं, ऊढ; pass. उह्यते) 1 To carry, lead, bear, convey, transport (oft. with two acc.); अजां ग्रामं वहति; वहति विधिहुतं या हविः Ś. 1. 1; न च हव्यं वहत्यग्निः Ms. 4. 249. --2 To bear along, cause to move onward, waft, propel; जलानि या तीरनिखातयूपा वहत्ययोध्यामनु राजधानीं R. 13. 61; त्रिस्रोतसं वहति यो गगनप्रतिष्ठां Ś. 7. 6; R. 11. 10. --3 To fetch, bring; वहति जलमियं Mu. 1. 4. --4 To bear, support, hold up, sustain; न गर्दभा वजिधुरं वहंति Mk. 4. 17; ताते चापद्वितीये वहति रणधुरां को भयस्यावकाशः Ve. 3. 5 ‘when my father is leading the van &c.’; वहति भुवनश्रेणीं शेषः फणाफलकस्थितां Bh. 2. 35, Ś. 7. 17; Me. 17. --5 To carry off; take away; अद्रेः शृंगं वहति (v. l. for हरति) पवनः किंस्विद् Me. 14. --6 To marry; यदूढया वारणराजहार्यया Ku. 5. 70; Ms. 3. 38. --7 To have, possess, bear; वहसि हि धनहार्यं पण्यभूतं शरीरं Mk. 1. 31; वहति विषधरान् पटीरजन्मा Bv. 1. 74. --8 To assume, exhibit, show; लक्ष्मीमुवाह सकलस्य शशांकमूर्तेः Ki. 2. 59, 9. 2. --9 To look to, attend to, take care of; मुग्धाया मे जनन्या योगक्षेमं वहस्व M. 4; तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहं Bg. 9. 22. --10 To suffer, feel, experience; Bv. 1. 94; so दुःखं, हर्षं, शोकं, तोषं &c. --11 (Intransitive in this and the following senses) To be borne or carried on, move or walk on; वहतं बलीवर्दौ वहतं Mk. 6; उत्थाय पुनरवहत् K.; Pt. 1. 43, 291. --12 To flow (as rivers); प्रत्यगूहुर्महानद्यः Mb.; परोपकाराय वहंति नद्यः Subhāṣ. --13 To blow (as wind); मंदं वहति मारुतः Rām.; वहति मलयसमीरे मदनमुपनिधाय Gīt. 5. --14 To breathe. --Caus. (वाहयति-ते) 1 To cause to bear or carry, cause to be brought or led. --2 To drive, impel, direct. --3 To traverse, pass or go over; स वाह्यते राजपथः शिवाभिः R. 16. 12; भवान्वाहयेदध्वशेषं Me. 38. --4 To use, carry; Bk. 14. 23. --5 To place in a boat. --6 To proceed, go. --7 To carry out, complete, finish. --8 To go to, visit. --Desid. (विवक्षति-ते) To wish to carry &c.

s: puM, (vahati Darati havyaM devArTamiti । vaha + “vahiSriSruyviti .” uRA॰ 4 । 51 । iti niH .) citrakaH । BallAtakaH । (yaTA, suSrute cikitsitasTAne 9 aDyAye । “maYjizWAkzO vAsako devadAru paTyAvahnI vyozaDAtrI viqaNgam ॥”) nimbUkaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ rePaH । iti tantram ॥ agniH । ityamaraH ॥ * ॥ tasya nAmAni yaTA, -- “te jAtavedasaH sarvve kalmAzaH kusumastaTA । dahanaH SozaRaScEva tarpaRaSca mahAbalaH । piwaraH patagaH svarRastvagADo BrAja eva ca ॥” anyatra tu nAmAntarARyuktAni yaTA, -- “jfmBakoddIpakaScEva viBramaBramaSoBanAH । avasaTyAhavanIyO dakziRAgnistaTE va ca । anvAhAryyo gArhapatya ityete daSa vahnayaH ॥” anyEranyaToktAni yaTA, -- “BrAjako raYjakaScEva kledakaH snehakastaTA । DArako banDakaScEva drAvakAKyaSca saptaDA । vyApakaH pAvakaScEva Slezmako daSamaH smftaH ॥” SarIrasTavahneH sTAnAni yaTA, -- “vahnayo dozadUzyezu saMlInA daSa dehinaH ॥” dozadUzyO yaTA, -- “vAtapittakaPA dozA dUzyAH syuH sapta DAtavaH ॥” iti sAradAtilakaH ॥ tatra nizidDakarmmARi yaTA, -- “nASudDo'gniM paricaret na devAn kIrttayedfzIn । na cAgniM laNGayedDImAn nopadaDyAdaDaH kvacit ॥ na cEnaM pAdataH kuryyAt muKena na DamedbuDaH । agnO na niHkzipedagniM nAdBiH praSamayettaTA ॥ na vahniM muKaniSvAsErjvAlayennASucirbbuDaH । svamagniM nEva hastena spfSennApasu ciraM vaset ॥ nApakzipennopaDame nna sUrpeRa ca pARinA । muKenAgniM saminnItaM muKAdagnirajAyata ॥” iti kOrmme upaviBAge 15 aDyAyaH ॥ asyotpattiryaTA, -- SOnaka uvAca । “sarvvaM SrutaM mahABAga paripUrRaM mano mama । aDunA SrItumicCAmi vahnerutpattimIpsitAm ॥ sUta uvAca । ekadA sfzwikAle ca brahmAnantamaheSvarAH । SvetadbIpaM yayuH sarvve drazwuM vizRuM jagatpatim ॥ parasparaYca saMBAzAM kftvA siMhAsanezu ca । UzuH sarvve saBAmaDye suramye purato hareH ॥ vizRugAtrodBavAstatra kAminyaH kamalAkalAH । tatra nftyanti gAyanti vizRugATASca susvaram ॥ tAsAYca kaWinAM SroRiM kaWinaM stanamaRqalam । sasmitaM muKapadmaYca dfzwvA brahmA sa kAmukaH ॥ mano nivAraRaM karttuM na SaSAka pitAmahaH । vIryyaM papAta cacCAda lajjayA vAsasA viBuH ॥ tadbIryyaM vastrasahitaM prataptaM kAmatApitaH । kzIrode prerayAmAsa saNgIte virate dvija ॥ jalAdutTAya puruzaH prajvalan brahmatejasA । uvAsa brahmaRaH kroqe lajjitasya ca saMsadi ॥ etasminnantare ruzwo jalAdutTAya satvaraH । praRamya varuRo devAn bAlaM netuM samudyataH ॥ bAlo daDAra brahmARaM bAhuByAYca BayAdrudan । kiYcinnovAca jagatAM viDAtA lajjayA dvija ॥ bAlakasya kare DftvA cakArAkarzaRaM ruzA । varuRaSca saBAmaDye taM cikzepa prajApatiH ॥ papAta dUrato devo varuRo durbbalastaTA । mUrcCAM saMprApa mftavat kopadfzwyA viDeraho ॥ cetanaM kArayAmAsAmftadfzwyA ca SaNkaraH । saMprApya cetanAM tatra tamuvAca jaleSvaraH ॥ varuRa uvAca । bAlo jale samudBUto mama puttro'yamIpsitaH । ahaM gfhItvA yAsyAmi brahmA mAM tAqayet kaTam ॥ brahmovAca । bAlakaH SaraRApanno mayi vizRo maheSvara । kaTaM dAsyAmi BItaYca rudantaM SaraRAgatam ॥ SaraRAgatadInArttaM yo naM rakzedapaRqitaH । pacyate niraye tAvad yAvaccandradivAkarO ॥ uBayorvvacanaM SrutvA prahasya maDusUdanaH । uvAca sarvvatattvajYaH sarvveSaSca yaTocitam ॥ BagavAnuvAca । dfzwvA sukAminISroRiM vIryyaM DAtuH papAta tat । lajjayA prerayAmAsa kzIrode nirmmale jale ॥ tato vaBUba bAlaSca Darmmato viDiputtrakaH । kzetrajaSca sutaH SAstre varuRasyApi gORataH ॥ mahAdeva uvAca । yo vidyAyonisambanvo vedezu ca nirUpitaH । Sizye puttre ca samatA ceti vedavido viduH ॥ mantraM dadAtu varuRo vidyAYca bAlakAya ca । puttro viDAturvvahniSca SizyaSca varuRasya ca ॥ vizRurdadAtu bAlAya dAhikAM SaktimulvaRAm । sarvvadagDo hutASaSca nirvvARo varuRena ca ॥ vizRuSca dAhikAM SaktiM dadO tasmE SivAjYayA । mantraM vidyAYca varuRo ratnamAlAM manoharAm ॥ kroqe kftvA ca taM bAlaM cucumba mAyayA suraH ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe vahnyutpattirnAma 130 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ taddAhanivAraROzaDAni yaTA, -- “sAmudrasEnDavayavA vidyuddagDA ca mfttikA । tayAnuliptaM yadveSma nAgninA dahyate nfpa ! ॥” iti mAtsye rAjaDarmme rAjarakzAnAma 193 aH ॥ agnivEkftyaM tacCAntiSca yaTA, -- “anagnirdIpyate yatra rAzwre yasya nirinDanaH । na dIpyate cenDanavAn sa rAzwraH pIqyate nfpEH ॥ prajvaledapsu mAsaM vA taTArdDaYcApi kiYcana । prAsAdatoraRadvAraM nfpaveSma surAlayam ॥ etAni yatra dahyante tatra rAjaBayaM Bavet । vidyutA vA pradahyante tatrApi nfpaterBayam ॥ DUmaScAnagnijo yatra tatra vidyAnmahadBayam । vinAgniM visPuliNgASca dfSyante yatra kutracit ॥ trirAtropozitaScAtra puroDAH susamAhitaH । samidBiH kzIravfkzARAM sarzapEstu Gftena ca ॥ dadyAt suvarRaYca taTA dvijeByo gAScEva vastrARi taTA BuvaYca । evaM kfte pApamupEti nASaM yadagnivEkftyaBavaM dbijendra ! ॥” iti tatrEvAdButaSAntiragnivEkftyaM nAma 205 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ muKyAgnayo yaTA, -- “gAhapatyo dakziRAgnistaTEvAhavanIyakaH । ete'gnayastrayo muKyAH SezAScopasadastrayaH ॥” iti vahnipurARe gaRaBedanAmADyAyaH ॥ * ॥ vahnivipramaDyagamananizeDo yaTA, -- “dvO viprO vahniviprO ca dampatyorguruSizyayoH । halAgre ca na gantavyaM brahmahatyA pade pade ॥” iti karmmalocanaH ॥ * ॥ api ca । “nAgnibrAhmaRayorantarA vyapeyAt nAgnyorna brAhmaRayorna guruSizyayoranujYayA tu vyapeyAt । iti tiTyAditattvaDftavacanam ॥ * ॥ aTa vahnistamBanam । “mAnuzasya vasAM gfhya jalOkAM tatra pezayet । hastO tu lepayettena agnistamBanamuttamam ॥ SAlmalIrasamAdAya svaramUtre niDAya tam । agnyAgAre kzipettena agnistamBanamuttamam ॥ vAyasI udaraM gfhya maRqUkavasayA saha । guqikAM kArayettena tato'gniM prakzipedvaSI ॥ evametatprayogeRa agnistamBanamuttamam । maRqotakavacAyuktaM marIcaM nAgaraM taTA ॥ carvvitvA ca imaM sadyo jihvayA jvalanaM lihet ॥ gorocanA BfNgarAjaM cUrRaM kftvA GftaM samam । divyastamBaSca pItvA syAnmantreRAnena vE taTA ॥” o~ agnistamBanaM kuru । iti gAruqe 186 aDyAyaH ॥ (dEtyaviSezaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 227 । 50 । “vARaH kArttasvaro vahnirviSvadaMzwro'Ta nErftiH ॥” mitravindAgarBajAtaH kfzRasya puttraviSezaH । yaTA, BAgavate । 10 । 61 । 16 । “mahAMSaH pAvano vahnirmitravindAtmajAH kzuDiH ॥” turvvasuputtraH । yaTA, harivaMSe । 32 । 117 । “turvvasostu suto vahnirgoBAnustasya cAtmajaH ॥” kukuraputtraH । yaTA, BAgavate । 9 । 24 । 19 । “kukurasya suto vahnirvilomA tanayastataH ॥”)

m: वह्नि m. any animal that draws or bears along, a draught animal, horse, team, RV.; AV.; VS.; TBr.

fire (in general or ‘the god of fire’), Mn.; MBh. &c. (वह्निना सं-√ स्कृ, to hallow by fire, burn solemnly)
the fire of digestion, VarBṛS.
N. of the number ‘three’ (fr. the three sacred fires), L.
N. of various plants (accord. to L. Plumbago Ceylanica; Semecarpus Anacardium; Poa Cynosuroides; and the citron tree), Suśr.
a mystical N. of the letter र्, Up.
N. of the 8th Kalpa (q.v.), Cat.
of a Daitya, MBh.
of a son of Kṛṣṇa, BhP.

a: वह्निः — [वह्-नि] 1 Fire; अतृणे पतितो वह्निः स्वयमेवोपशाम्यति Subhāṣ. --2 The digestive faculty, gastric fluid. --3 Digestion, appetite. --4 A vehicle. --5 The marking-nut plant. --6 Lead-wort. --7 A sacrificer, priest. --8 A god in general. --9 An epithet of the Maruts. --10 Of Soma. --11 A horse. --Comp. --कर a. {1} igniting. {2} stimulating digestion, stomachic. --काष्ठं a kind of agallochum. --गंधः {1} incense. {2} resin. --गर्भः {1} a bamboo. {2} the Śamī tree; cf. अग्निगर्भ. --दपिकः safflower. --नामन् m. {1} the marking nut plant. {2} lead-wort. --भोग्यं clarified butter. --मित्रः air, wind. --रेतस् m. {1} an epithet of Śiva. {2} gold. --लोहं, --लोहकं copper. --वर्णं the red waterlily. --वल्लभः resin. --वीजं {1} gold. {2} the common lime. --शिखं {1} saffron. {2} safflower. --सखः the wind. --संज्ञकः the Citraka tree.
